text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly trimming winners can leave me underexposed if a trend continues; set position-size and exit rules instead of selling just because a gain looks large.","I sold Stock D at a loss and later bought it back at a higher price, so I should avoid reactive reversals and reassess the reason for a trade before re-entering.","My account has risen overall, but these ten periods do not show whether I beat the market; compare results with a suitable benchmark over a longer horizon."]}
